parameters.help_en:
The writing type:
generateProductTitle: Generates a product title.
productTitleTranslation: Translates a product title.
generateProductSummary: Generates a product summary.
productRedBook: Generates a Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) post about a product.
productEvaluating: Generates a product assessment copy.
circleOfFriends: Generates promotional marketing copy suitable for WeChat Moments.
marketingActivities: Generates promotional copy for marketing campaigns.
productAdvertisement: Generates an advertising slogan for a company or product.
travel: Generates a marketing promotion article for travel.
other: Other types of marketing copy

parameters.help_en:
Extension parameters. This is a map structure where all parameter values are of the string type:

- enableThinking: Specifies whether to enable the thinking mode. Valid values: "true" or "false".

- thinkingBudget: The budget for the thinking mode. This is an integer in the string format.

- resultFormat: The result format. This is used to set the output format.

- incrementalOutput: Specifies whether to enable incremental output. Valid values: "true" or "false"
parameters.help_zh:
扩展参数（Map结构，所有参数值均为 String 类型）：
- enableThinking：是否启用思考模式，取值为 "true" 或 "false"
- thinkingBudget：思考预算，用于控制思考模式的预算（整数，字符串形式）
- resultFormat：结果格式，用于设置输出格式
- incrementalOutput：是否启用增量输出，取值为 "true" 或 "false"
parameters.name: ext_parameters
